research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: UroDev Medical is engaged in research and development of a urinary catheter with retention features, as described in the title and abstract. Their work focuses on a catheter that can be retained inside the body for extended periods, incorporating a tube with a lumen and outer surface, and a retainer. The system includes a catheter mating device designed to connect, move, or remove the catheter from the body, supporting advancements in fully-internal bladder management solutions.

overview_description.description: UroDev Medical designs devices to improve the quality of life for people with Spinal Cord Injury and Disease. Their first product, The Connected Catheter, will revolutionize the way millions of people deal manage their bladders.
